title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Thu 05 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast moderate). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 08:45 to about 16:30. The evening before, the page called it normal, about 5,000 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,000 ft by the Kekoa camera, right on the evening's number; the morning update said about 5,000 ft and was right on. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 14:52, crossing Kula Highway near Kamehameha Schools; furthest south about 17:22, crossing Kula Highway at the middle Lower Kula Road junction. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); Kamehamenui 1 stopped at 13:48; Kula 1 stopped at 13:48; Kaonoulu 1 stopped at 15:26; Waihou Springs 1 stopped at 15:26; the Mesonet could not be reached on 16 of 48 updates.
